added.summary: Every look has five generated pictures as nine-slice classes: an octagon item or ability `nine-socket`, its `nine-socket-rim` (a white mask the element's bg colours, such as a rarity), a radial `nine-glow` (a mask the bg colours), a `nine-sheen` and an ornate gold `nine-card-frame` with an open centre.

fixed.summary: The notification's mark, a daily quest's well and a quest reward sit in an octagon socket whose rim takes the tone (gold when done or unique), and the versus badge glows from its top, instead of gradient squares.
